title: Disaster Management
sources_used: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: Describe the impact of droughts in India.
questions.solution_html:
• / Droughts lead to crop failure, water scarcity, and forced
  • migration, severely affecting rural livelihoods and food security.
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025
questions.final_answer: migration, severely affecting rural livelihoods and food security.

questions.question: Analyse the role of disaster management in protecting the environment.
questions.solution_html:
• / Disaster management reduces environmental degradation by
  • promoting sustainable use of natural resources and proactive mitigation
  • planning.
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

  • crises.

questions.question: Examine the phase Prevention.
questions.solution_html:
• / The prevention phase focuses on identifying hazards and
  • implementing structural and non-structural measures to minimize
  • disaster impact.
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: Define Disaster.
questions.solution_html:
• / A disaster is a sudden disruptive event causing widespread
  • human, material, and environmental losses exceeding local coping
  • capacity.
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: Describe the social factors that increase disaster risk.
questions.solution_html:
• / Social inequality, poverty, and poor governance elevate
  • disaster risk by weakening resilience and adaptive capacity.
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025
questions.final_answer: disaster risk by weakening resilience and adaptive capacity.

questions.question: Compare vulnerability in urban and rural areas.
questions.solution_html:
• / Urban areas face infrastructure collapse; rural regions
  • experience livelihood disruptions, reflecting different vulnerability
  • dimensions.
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: Examine how elderly people face higher vulnerability in disasters.
questions.solution_html:
• / Elderly people face higher vulnerability due to health issues,
  • dependency, and limited mobility during emergencies.
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025
questions.final_answer: dependency, and limited mobility during emergencies.

  • response and reduces fatalities in mass casualty situations.
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: Examine the concept development.
questions.solution_html:
• / Development involves structured social and economic
  • progress aiming to enhance quality of life and reduce vulnerability.
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: Differntiate development and disaster.
questions.solution_html:
• / Development and disaster are inversely related—progress
  • builds resilience, while disasters reverse human gains.
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025
questions.final_answer: builds resilience, while disasters reverse human gains.
